research.title: Occlusion-Aware Feature Aggregation for Object Detection
bullets: Formulated whether visibility estimates could improve detection under partial occlusion and led development of a visibility-weighted feature aggregation module.
Designed controlled occlusion experiments and component ablations to examine localization errors, missed detections, and sensitivity to visibility estimation.

research.title: Uncertainty-Guided Adaptation for Semantic Segmentation
bullets: Formulated how class-dependent uncertainty affects segmentation adaptation across visual domains and led development of class-aware pseudo-label selection with consistency regularization.
Developed an uncertainty calibration procedure and evaluated adaptation behavior through classwise error analysis, threshold ablations, and comparisons against self-training baselines.

publications.title: Class-Aware Pseudo-Label Selection for Semantic Segmentation Across Visual Domains
Calibrating Class-Dependent Uncertainty for Consistent Segmentation Adaptation

work.title: Image Processing Service Implementation and Maintenance
bullets: Implemented image validation, resizing, and normalization components for an image ingestion service, including explicit handling of malformed inputs.
Maintained automated regression tests, investigated processing failures from service logs, and coordinated interface changes with downstream application developers.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Classification Transfer Strategies
bullets: Implemented frozen-feature classification and end-to-end fine-tuning using pretrained convolutional networks, maintaining consistent preprocessing and data partitions across experiments.
Compared classification errors, training behavior, and sensitivity to augmentation choices, inspecting confusion patterns to identify differences between transfer strategies.

projects.title: Local Feature Matching Under Viewpoint Changes
bullets: Implemented patch descriptors, nearest-neighbor matching, and robust homography estimation for image pairs with changes in viewpoint and illumination.
Compared descriptor normalization and match filtering strategies using reprojection errors and qualitative correspondence inspection under a shared evaluation protocol.

projects.title: Image Denoising with Classical Filters and Convolutional Models
bullets: Implemented bilateral filtering and a convolutional denoising baseline, generating matched noisy inputs to support controlled comparisons across restoration approaches.
Evaluated reconstruction quality and edge preservation across noise conditions, examining residual images to characterize oversmoothing and remaining noise artifacts.
